description: Inspects a select-like control, automatically bringing it into view, temporarily opening custom controls to discover options, and restoring the original open state.

id.description: Preferred canonical select control ID from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: CSS selector for the select control. It must resolve to exactly one control; narrow broad selectors when the page contains multiple selects.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select-like control.

query.description: Filters currently discovered option labels; it does not enter text into the control.

maxOptions.description: Maximum number of currently discovered options to return.

timeout.description: Maximum temporary exploration time in seconds. Omit or pass 0 to use 300 seconds.

purpose.description: Describe which control choices must be understood, such as enumerating options, checking search, loading more results, or inspecting a cascading picker
